name: Cursor Projects: Outer Loop / Inner Loop
summary: Plans and launches Cursor Projects with an outer loop / inner loop setup: a Project coordinator owns the build, and an Outer Loop bot feeds it context packs.
summary_zh: 用外环/内环结构规划并启动 Cursor Projects：由 Project 协调者负责构建，配套的 Outer Loop bot 给它送去干净的上下文包。
